_설명: 「마지막 정비 명령」 인물. look = 얼굴·몸(그림 주문에 그대로), outfit = 평소 옷, face = 사용자 확인한 캐릭터 시트

chars.name: 보리
chars.look: a tall slender old maintenance robot, rounded white ceramic body shell with rust stains, scratches and small patches of green moss, round head with two round soft-blue glowing eyes, thin jointed metal arms with three-fingered hands, two thin metal legs, a small tool pouch on its hip
chars.look_ko: 키 크고 마른 낡은 정비 로봇, 녹·이끼 낀 흰 몸통, 둥근 머리에 파랗게 빛나는 둥근 눈 두 개, 세 손가락 손, 허리에 공구 주머니
chars.outfit: no clothes, a faded green scarf tied around its neck

chars.name: 루미
chars.look: a 10-year-old Korean girl, short black bob hair with a small yellow star hair clip, big round brown eyes, small and slim
chars.look_ko: 10살 소녀, 노란 별 핀을 꽂은 짧은 단발, 크고 동그란 갈색 눈, 작고 마른 체구
chars.outfit: an oversized bright yellow raincoat, red rubber boots, a small silver round locket necklace

chars.name: 도현
chars.look: a Korean man in his late 30s, Rumi's father, short messy black hair, light stubble, tired kind eyes, lean build
chars.look_ko: 30대 후반 루미 아빠, 헝클어진 짧은 머리, 짧은 수염, 피곤하지만 다정한 눈
chars.outfit: a worn grey salvage-crew work jacket with many pockets, brown work boots, goggles pushed up on his forehead

chars.name: 강철수
chars.look: a huge heavy-set Korean man in his 50s, scavenger boss, shaved head, a long scar on his left cheek, thick neck, small cold eyes
chars.look_ko: 50대 고철 수거단 두목, 덩치 큼, 민머리, 왼뺨 긴 흉터, 작고 차가운 눈
chars.outfit: a long black leather coat with riveted metal patches, heavy black boots, a big wrench on his belt

chars.name: 윤서
chars.look: a Korean woman engineer in her early 30s from 300 years ago, long black hair in a low ponytail, gentle determined eyes, slim
chars.look_ko: 300년 전 30대 초반 여성 기술자, 낮게 묶은 긴 머리, 다정하고 단단한 눈
chars.outfit: a white engineer coat over a light blue shirt, the same small silver round locket necklace
